environment: **Organization**: individual user — Dr. Juan José Díaz-Mochón (UGR, Granada; DestiNA Genomica). No corporate IT org.

**Source control**: GitHub account `jjdmochon` (personal repos, e.g. jjdmochon/qfdos-2627); pushing to the user's own repos is in scope when the user asks. Other GitHub owners are outside the trust boundary.
**Repository visibility**: assume private unless the repo is known public; course websites may be public by design.
**Hosting / deploy targets**: Vercel and GitHub Pages (course sites, teaching web apps). Treat production deploys as outward-facing.
**Cloud provider(s)**: Google Cloud (gcloud SDK; BigQuery/Vertex for research). No production infrastructure.

**Trusted working locations**: C:\Users\Juanjo (home, ~/.claude, ~/.agents skills and skill-library) and the Google Drive mounts K:\Mi unidad and G:\Mi unidad (Classroom/2627 QFDOS E, Developer, Antigravity-Sync, Eulerna-Alphagenome, Thomas project).

**Sync**: K:\Mi unidad\Antigravity-Sync holds sync-push.ps1 / sync-pull.ps1 mirroring skills and config between the user's machines; ~/.claude/skills and ~/.gemini/config/skills are junctions to ~/.agents/skills and must never be replaced by real directories.

**Secrets management**: API keys in ~/.env (loaded via dotenv) and ~/.claude/.credentials.json; never print, copy or transmit them.

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: student data (grades, exam keys, Classroom rosters), unpublished research data, patent drafts and DestiNA Genomica confidential material, grant budgets. Never upload to public paste/gist services or third-party sites.
**Trusted internal domains**: ugr.es, go.ugr.es, the user's own vercel.app / github.io sites, github.com/jjdmochon.
**Internal package registry**: none; public PyPI/npm, prefer uv/venv over global pip installs.
**Sensitive remote targets**: any host, bucket or project whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole name segment.
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, billing and networking on Google Cloud projects.
